book.name: Maliku
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Maliku gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Kune ki ba kuŋ bɛ kwɛse
Jiso ja yo, wu gɛɛŋ kimbe ki woŋ kì Judia le, wu daŋ Joo yì Jodaŋ wu gɛɛŋ wuŋ kwege. Binchvu bi bamii ka bi taashi bi too fɛ wu le, wu tu wu yɛyi bo gɛh no wu gɛ̀ to wu yɛyi.
Bafalashii gɛ̀ ja bo to fɛ wu le ki bo moŋ wu, bo mo bo biih wu le lɛ, “Nchi le wu bɛɛŋ lɛ taŋlo muh kuŋ bɛ kwɛɛ?”
Jiso kaasɛ wu biih tɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Musɛ gɛ̀ nya nchi lɛ bɛŋ gêe nɛɛ?”

content: Bo chvuu lɛ, “Musɛ gɛ̀ bee wu chinɛ lɛ taŋlo muh kuŋ bɛ kwɛɛ. Wu nɛ kuŋe bɛ wu, wu saŋ ŋwa wù duunyi lɛ wu le wu kuŋ wa wu, wu nya wu le.”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ̀ bee nje bintuŋ biɛna bì tɛmɛ wù Musɛ gɛ̀ saŋ nchi wunɛ.
Geenɛ, gɛ̀ bee fɛŋkɛɛ sege Nyo gɛ̀ fɛde mwɛɛ, wu fɛ jwɛŋsɛ bɛ kwɛse. No wu fɛ noo wu jɛmɛ lɛ,
‘Le nje finɛ fiɛɛ fì jwɛŋsɛ lé wu gê wu chinɛ chiji bɛ bwee le wu taashɛ bɛ kwɛɛ,
bo bafɛɛ mo bo tu muh wu mumwaa.’ Noo, gɛ bo baaŋ bamii bafɛɛ gɛ, bo le wa muh wu mumwaa.
Fi mo fì nyu lɛ, fiɛɛ fì Nyo le wu taashɛ wa, keefɛ muh moŋ ki wu gâsɛ gɛ.”

content: Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ doo bo nyu yeh, bo ka bo biih wu le kune fiɛɛ fiyu.
Wu chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Mo yɛɛŋ wù kuŋ bɛ kwɛɛ wu jo wumu, le wu ge kimbefɛ gɛh njɛ ki wu jâŋ kwɛse wumu.
Nɛ kwɛse bu a jwɛŋsɛ le, wu gɛɛŋ a jwɛŋsɛ wumu le, tu wu le wu ge kimbefɛ fɛ jwɛŋsɛ le ki wu gîiŋ bɛ jwɛŋsɛ wumu.”

content: Jiso noŋ kimbonɛ yi booŋ ba shige shige le
Bamii ja bo too bɛ booŋ fɛ Jiso le lɛ wu kuŋ bo le, booŋ be ba ŋgoo tu bo wame lo bo.
Jiso doo wu yɛŋ noo, shɛ́ŋ toonyɛ wu, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ chînɛ booŋ bayu too fɛ mɛne, fɛ bɛŋ jêese bo gɛ, nje bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le nyu fɛ bamii ba le njɛ booŋ banɛ le.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ muh wù baaŋ fi gɛ bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo njɛ mwa wù shige gɛ, tu gɛ wu lee bvunfoŋ bvuyu le gɛ.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu jode bo wu tuude, wu gɛɛde chiaaŋ yi bo le, wu nooŋ kimbonɛ yi bo le.
Jiso bɛ muh wu kwa
Jiso ja lɛ wu gɛɛne, muh mu legɛ wu to wu tuŋ anyuu a wu jii wu biih wu le lɛ, “Muh wù N'yɛyɛ, wo le muh wù joŋe, fiɛɛ fì ŋkɛme ki ŋge fɛ ŋkɛme kinche kì kage gɛ le la?”
Jiso biih wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo tɛŋe mɛ lɛ muh wù joŋe nje la? Gɛ muh nyu yu wù joŋe gɛ. Mɛ gɛh Nyo maa wù joŋe.

Gɛ wo kee banchi ba duu lɛ, ‘Keefɛ wo yûuyɛ muh gɛ, keefɛ wo jâŋ kwɛ muh gɛ, keefɛ wo chôŋ bvuchoŋ gɛ, keefɛ wo bɛ̂ɛ jiŋ yi nsa wu chimbiaŋ gɛ, keefɛ wo fîge kinfi gɛ, bɛ lɛ wo ŋgvûune chijo bɛ bwoo gɛ?’”

content: Muh wuyu chvuu Jiso le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, banchi banɛ bachii le ŋgɛ̀ ŋkɛ wa ŋgɛɛde mbaaŋ chumu.”
Jiso bijɛ wu nɛ tuŋŋ, wu koŋ wu, wu mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Tu fiɛɛ le fi shɛɛ fimimia fì wo baaŋ wo ge. Gɛ̂nɛ wo gêsɛ mwɛɛ mwuŋ munchii mù wo kɛme, wo gâ bige biyu bamii ba fuude le, wo mo wo ge wo kɛme nchvu nyu yi woŋ wù fɛwe. Nɛ wo doo wo ge noo, wo mo wo kâasɛ wo tô wo bîi mɛne.”

content: No Jiso jɛmɛ noo, muh wuyu yu bvushi chvuu lo wu, wu kaasɛ ye wu tu wu gɛɛne wù nyu lo yii yii, nje wu gɛ̀ kɛme kwa baaŋ.
Jiso ja wu kaasɛ ye wu bijɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo nɛɛ, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Fi lé fi gê fi tɛɛme baaŋ fɛ bamii ba kwa le, ki bo lee yi bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le.”

content: Njɛmɛ wuyu fuuŋsɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo. Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Booŋ baŋ, fi tɛɛme baaŋ fɛ muh le ki wu lêe yi bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le.
Fi le chige fɛ nyambala le ki yi lêe a jise chi nsala le fede fɛ muh wu kwa le ki wu lêe yi bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le.”

content: Bo yu noo fi gha bo baaŋ, bo tu bo maŋe lɛ, “Nɛ finɛ le noo, yu to bonɛ yɛɛŋ?”
Jiso kaasɛ wu bijɛ bo nɛɛ, wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Finɛ fiɛɛ taŋlo fi gha muh wu wuŋ, geenɛ gɛ taŋlo fi gha Nyo gɛ, nje Nyo taŋlo wu ge fiɛɛ fichii.”

content: Bita mo wu ja wu jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Bîjɛ yɛ̂ŋ, bee le be chinɛ wa fiɛɛ fichii le bee tu be bii wo le.”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe wo nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, gɛ muh nyu yu wu le wu chinɛ yeh ye le, kɛnɛ booŋ ba bwee le, kɛnɛ jɛ́me ye le, kɛnɛ bwee le, kɛnɛ chiji le, kɛnɛ booŋ le, kɛnɛ ŋɛɛ le, wu chine nje mɛ bɛ saaka wù joŋe wu Nyo,

wù lé wu gê wù nyu njɛ wù kɛme yéh mo booŋ ba bwee, mo jɛ́me, mo babwee, mo booŋ, mo ŋɛɛ yi kinche ki mɛɛse le kiŋgane gwii gɛ. Bamii lé bo gê bo boone tɛ bikaa a wu jiŋ, ge doo nyume kife ki kinche kì too le, wù kɛme kinche kì kage gɛ.
Geenɛ, bamii ba duude ba le fwe mɛɛse le bo tu ba ajiŋ, ba duude ba le ajiŋ mɛɛse le bo tu ba fwe.”

content: Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ kiŋgane kintɛde kune kwe ye

Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ ja bo jo je, bo bɛɛne Yɛlusalɛm wu saa fwe. Booŋ be ba ŋgoo kɛme lo ŋgha. Bamii ba gɛ̀ bii tɛ tu bo kɛme nfaaŋ. Jiso ka wu jo booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ bɛ bo kɛŋsɛ yo wu tu wu sɛŋe bo fiɛɛ fì lé fi gê fi kooshɛ bɛ wu.
Wu jɛme bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, bee bɛɛne wa bee gɛɛne Yɛlusalɛm, ba lé ba gɛ̂ɛŋ ba nya muh wù jee che le Mwamuh chiaaŋ yi bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ le mo bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo, ba sa wu ba suunɛ lɛ ba yuuyɛ wu, ba mo ba nya wu chiaaŋ yi bituŋ le,
ba chwɛɛse wu, ba chuuyi wu bɛ nchwene ye ye le, ba taane wu bɛ munte, ba yuuyɛ wu, ge doo nyume aju atade, wu bu yi kwe le.”

content: Jɛm bɛ Joŋ lɛgɛ binta bì baaŋ baaŋ a Jiso le
Jɛm bɛ Joŋ ba gɛ̀ bee booŋ ba Jɛbɛdi ja bo kɛŋsɛ bo to a Jiso fwe bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, fiɛɛ le yu fì bee goone lɛ wo ge fɛ bee le.”
Wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ goone lɛ ŋge la fɛ bɛŋ le?”

content: Bo chvuu lɛ, “Bee goone lɛ sege wo le yi kala wu bvukugɛ bwuŋ le, bee shii yi binta bì baaŋ baaŋ le, muh mu a kibo kuŋ kinchiɛɛŋ le, wumu a kibo kiŋkoŋo le.”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ bɛŋ kee fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ biide gɛ. Taŋlo bɛŋ mu fiŋkoo fi ŋgɛ fì nlé ŋgê mmû, kɛnɛ bɛŋ lêe kfuu chi ŋgɛ wù baaŋ wù nlé ŋgê nlee wu le?”

content: Bo chvuu wu le lɛ, “Bee taŋlo be ge.” Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ taŋlo bɛŋ mu fiŋkoo fi ŋgɛ fì nlé ŋgê mu, bɛŋ lêe tɛ kfuu chi ŋgɛ wù baaŋ wù nlé ŋgê nlee le,
geenɛ ki bɛŋ shîi a kibo kaŋ kinchiɛɛŋ le kɛnɛ kiŋkoŋo le gɛ nyume kijusɛ kaŋ ki nya muh le gɛ. Manjuu mayu le fɛ bamii ba ba le ba seesɛ wa fɛ bo le.”

content: Kimbɛge ki booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso ba yuufe doo bo yu kune fiɛɛ fiyu bo tu bo toonyi shɛ́ŋ bɛ Jɛm mo Joŋ.
Jiso tɛɛŋ bo bachii bo to, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ bɛŋ kee lɛ bamii ba sage bituŋ to bo shiide lo yi bamii baboo le, bamii ba baaŋ baaŋ baboo duunyi bvuŋga bvuboo a bo we gɛ?
Gɛ fifiɛɛ fiɛɛ kɛme ki fi nyume a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ gɛ. Muh wù goone ki wu nyûme muh wù baaŋ a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ kɛme ki wu nyûme muh wù lɛne lo bɛŋ le.
Muh nɛ goone ki wu nyûme muh wù fwe a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ, tu wù kɛme ki wù nyu nfwa wù muh wuchii.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ gɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh gɛ̀ to lɛ bamii lɛne lo wu le gɛ. Wu gɛ̀ to ki wu lɛ̂ŋ lo bamii le, wu nya kinche ke ki wu sûuŋ muh wù duude chiaaŋ yi kwe le.”

content: Jiso gwenyɛ ajii a Batimayu
Bo jiɛnyɛ bo to bo bu ntɛ wu Jɛliku le. Jiso gɛ̀ doo wu jade yo bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo mo kinchvu ki bamii kì baaŋ, kinfeeŋ kimi shii jwe wu je le ki lɛge mwɛɛ jee che nyu lɛ Batimayu, wù mwa Timayu.
Wu doo wu yu lɛ le Jiso wu Nasalɛ, wu mo wu kɛ wu tu wanɛ fɛwɛɛwe lɛ, “Jiso, Mwa Nfoŋ Dabi, koo yii fɛ mɛne.”
Bamii ba duude tu bo wanɛ bo duu lɛ wu baŋ lo. Geenɛ wu ka wu mɛsɛ wu waŋ lo fɛwɛɛwe lɛ, “Mwa Nfoŋ Dabi, koo yii fɛ mɛne.”
Jiso lɛɛŋ, wu jɛmɛ lɛ bo tɛɛŋ wu. Bo mo bo tɛɛŋ kinfeeŋ kiyu bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Wo le wo kɛme kishi kì joŋe, ja we, wu tɛŋe wo.”
Kinfeeŋ kiyu mo ki noŋ nju ye fɛkuu, ki selɛ we ki gɛɛŋ fɛ Jiso le.
Jiso biih ki le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo goone lɛ ŋge la fɛ wo le?”

content: Kinfeeŋ kiyu chvuu lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, ŋkoŋe kì n'yɛne mwɛɛ le.”
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo gɛɛne fiuŋ. Fitele fì wo leese yi ye yaŋ le, le fi ge wa ajii awo gwenyɛ.”

content: Kimimia noo ajii awe mo a yuu wu tu wu yɛne mwɛɛ le, wu tu wu bii Jiso le a wu gɛ̀ gɛɛne yo.

footnotes.text: Baŋwa ba kege bamu kɛme fɛnɛ lɛ, “Fɛ muh wù gɛɛde bvufee yi kwa le…”
